display.purpose: Landing wordmark and not-found title, on flap cells.

headline.purpose: Page titles, board service names, chat wordmark and station clock, on flap cells.

numeral.purpose: Stat strip values and category counts, on flap cells, left-padded to three cells.

title.purpose: Board panel headings, uppercase, no cells.

body.purpose: Guest entries, field values, slip answers (1.625 line-height on slips), landing lead.

body-sm.purpose: Destination copy, subtitles, helper and error text, chips, category names.

label.purpose: Board column headers, stat names, entry labels; names a value, never a kicker.

plate.purpose: Landing role plates and the not-found home link, uppercase.

shadows.name: flap-cell
shadows.purpose: Every flap cell, with its two-leaf gradient (#1d2126 / #15181c) and 1px black hinge line.

shadows.name: field-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Focused text fields, alongside a signal border.

motion.name: flap
motion.value: 180ms cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0.2, 1); perspective(240px) rotateX(70deg) + brightness(1.6) to rest
motion.purpose: Top leaf drops onto the new character after the riffle.

motion.name: flap-riffle
motion.value: 3 random glyphs 55ms apart, 28ms stagger per cell
motion.purpose: A changed flap cell cycles before settling; at most one authored mount riffle per page.

motion.name: row-lit
motion.value: 1400ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); signal at 16% fading to transparent
motion.purpose: A stat cell or category row whose value changed brightens, then settles. This replaces any Live badge.

motion.name: typing-cell
motion.purpose: Typing indicator slats light amber one at a time.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover and focus colour changes on buttons, chips, fields and rows.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all animation and transition durations to 0.01ms; flap cells switch instantly

narrative.overview:
The hotel runs like the concourse at Cincinnati's Union Terminal. Roles, statuses and statistics are posted on a split-flap departures board: a slat-black field, ivory lettering on hinged flap cells, hairline rules between rows, and signal-amber plates for the one thing you can do next. The guest's conversation is the enquiry window under the board. You post your question on a slat, and the concierge hands back an ivory printed slip. The admin dashboard is the same board seen from the station office. Its numbers riffle and its rows brighten when guests ask something, and that motion is the proof that it is live.

Density is board-like and deliberate. Rows are tall (20 to 24px of vertical padding), columns are fixed-width the way a departures board fixes its "Service / Destination / Status" columns, and prose is kept short and set in a highly legible humanist sans so the flap lettering can carry the character. The palette is dark by nature (`color-scheme: dark`) with no light theme. The board is the only environment.

The build explicitly refuses the white chat column with a rounded-card dashboard: no soft pastel bubbles, no floating cards on a grey page, no pill-shaped everything.
keyCharacteristics: Split-flap cells (Big Shoulders Display, 800, uppercase, a 1px hinge line across the middle) for names, titles, the clock and every count.
One action hue: signal amber plates with board-black lettering.
Ivory slips for every assistant answer; guest entries stay on slat.
Hairline-ruled rows and a heavier 2px rule under every board header.
Flat surfaces, with depth from an eight-step slat ladder and only two shadows.
Motion is mechanical: riffle, drop, brighten, step. Nothing bounces.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal amber is the only action colour. Every primary action is an amber plate with board-black lettering, and no other hue ever fills a button. Green and red are status, never action.

rules.name: The Slat Ladder Rule
rules.body: Surfaces, rules and lettering come only from the ladder board → slat → slat-raised → rule → heavy rule → muted → dim → flap ivory. Never introduce a grey from outside it. The flap cell's two leaves (see Components) are that cell's own material, not palette colours.

rules.name: The Ivory Slip Rule
rules.body: Slip ivory means "the concierge said this". It backs the welcome line, every grounded answer, and the canned fallback (`I'm sorry, I don't have that information right now.`). Nothing else is ivory-backed, and assistant answers never sit on slat.

rules.name: The Slats Are for Names and Numbers Rule
rules.body: Flap cells carry the hotel name, page and service titles, the clock and counts. They never carry a sentence, a button label or form text. Prose, labels, fields and buttons are always Atkinson.

rules.name: The Read-Once Rule
rules.body: Flap text is read by assistive tech exactly once. As a name, it is screen-reader text plus hidden cells. As a value, the cells themselves are the text, so that the number stays the element's text content. Never let a screen reader spell a word out cell by cell.

rules.name: The Label Names a Value Rule
rules.body: The tracked uppercase label sits over a column or names the value beside or below it. It is never a kicker above a headline.

rules.name: The Flat Board Rule
rules.body: Panels, buttons, chips, fields and stat cells carry no shadow. If something needs to feel raised, move it one step up the slat ladder or give it a rule.

dos: **Do** label the two landing role controls exactly "Admin" and "Regular User". These strings are the accessible names, and CSS may set them in capitals.
**Do** keep the hotel name "Cincinnati Hotel" in the wordmark, headers and copy.
**Do** show real time by riffling flap digits and the row-lit flash (16% signal wash, 1400ms) on the stat or row that changed.
**Do** put every primary action on a signal amber plate with board-black lettering (`signal` / `board`, 10:1).
**Do** set every assistant answer, including the welcome line and the canned fallback, on an ivory slip with slip ink.
**Do** load Big Shoulders Display (slats) and Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (prose) from Google Fonts, and keep the fallbacks in the stacks.

**Do** keep the accessible names the e2e suite uses: heading "Admin dashboard", link "Regular User", textbox "Message the hotel assistant", button "Send message", log "Conversation", form "Contact details", fields "Name" / "Phone" / "Email", button "Send details", the status "Thanks, our team will contact you shortly.", and the "Questions asked" label whose stat value is a paragraph with the `tabular-nums` class.
**Do** keep every control at 44px minimum height and the focus outline at 2px signal with 2px offset.
**Do** collapse every animation under `prefers-reduced-motion`. Flap cells then switch characters instantly.
donts: **Don't** add a "Live" badge, pulsing dot or "real-time" chip. The board moving is the proof.
**Don't** give an action any accent hue other than signal amber. Secondary and ghost actions stay on the slat ladder. Don't make go or stop into actions.
**Don't** put assistant answers on slat, or guest entries on ivory.
**Don't** set sentences, button labels or form text in flap cells.
**Don't** build the white chat column with rounded floating cards, pill bubbles or a light theme.
**Don't** add shadows to panels, buttons, fields or chips. Only flap cells and slips cast one.
**Don't** introduce greys outside the slat ladder, or radii above 3px.
**Don't** let a screen reader read flap cells letter by letter.
